AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Starchart tracks the user's habit goals (e.g. gym, reading) as completions per 7- or 14-day period, with a pace for where they should be by now. Operational Patterns: - Call 'getGoals' to answer questions about progress or to find a goal's exact name. - When the user says they did a goal, call 'openGoalSlider' with its name; the user logs it by finishing the slider. There is no way to log a goal directly.
